CustomField.description: Boolean formula that returns TRUE when this gift is exactly in the Entry band — either its own CurrentAmount lands in the Entry one-time band, or (installment inheritance) its parent GiftCommitment.ExpectedTotalCmtAmount lands in the Entry lifetime band, and neither dimension puts it into Mid or Major. The three gift checkboxes (Entry / Mid / Major) are mutually exclusive — at most one is TRUE for any gift. Installment inheritance: a payment against a large commitment inherits the commitment's grouping, so a $100 payment against a $100k commitment is a Major gift, not an Entry one. Thresholds are configured via Setup → Custom Metadata Types → FQS Donor Grouping or the FQS Setup screen flow. Changing threshold values recalculates this field across all Gift Transaction records retroactively — no redeployment or batch job required.
CustomField.formula: AND( OR( AND( CurrentAmount >= $CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Grouping__mdt.Entry.One_Time_Min_Amount__c, CurrentAmount < $CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Grouping__mdt.Mid.One_Time_Min_Amount__c ), AND( GiftCommitment.ExpectedTotalCmtAmount >= $CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Grouping__mdt.Entry.Lifetime_Min_Amount__c, GiftCommitment.ExpectedTotalCmtAmount < $CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Grouping__mdt.Mid.Lifetime_Min_Amount__c ) ), NOT(CurrentAmount >= $CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Grouping__mdt.Mid.One_Time_Min_Amount__c), NOT(GiftCommitment.ExpectedTotalCmtAmount >= $CustomMetadata.FQS_Donor_Grouping__mdt.Mid.Lifetime_Min_Amount__c) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Automatically calculated. The field is checked when this gift's amount qualifies for the Entry donor grouping, or when it is an installment payment against an Entry-grouping commitment. Your administrator controls the threshold amounts.
CustomField.label: Is Entry Gift
